Correct a scalar PR-AUC from its design prevalence to a target prevalence

Source: R/fn_average_precision.R
ap_scalar_to_prev.Rd

Given a reported PR-AUC measured at design prevalence pi0, recover the equal-variance binormal ROC that reproduces it (ap_binormal), then re-integrate precision at pi_target. Use when only a summary PR-AUC and the prevalence it was measured at are available.

Usage

ap_scalar_to_prev(pr_auc, pi0, pi_target, grid = 20000)

Arguments

pr_auc

Reported PR-AUC (average precision) at the design prevalence.

pi0

Design/evaluation prevalence the pr_auc was measured at.

pi_target

Target landscape prevalence to re-price to.

grid

Number of recall points passed to ap_binormal.

Value

List with ap_target (PR-AUC at pi_target), the fitted mu, and the implied_roc_auc = pnorm(mu / sqrt(2)).
